props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while
keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
controlling animation with Vue animation libraries.

props.name: unmountOnHide
props.description:
Per-panel override of the root's `unmountOnHide`. Set `true` on a panel
whose subtree writes styles from main-thread worklets (`setStyleProperty`,
`animate(…, fill: 'forwards')`): those writes land on the native style
object outside the background thread's diffing, and such nodes have been
seen to keep painting through the kept-alive hide on device.

props.name: value
props.description: A unique value that associates the content with a trigger.
